articles.headline: Google to launch prototype satellite for first in-orbit test of Project Suncatcher
articles.summary: Google said it will launch a prototype satellite next week as part of Project Suncatcher, a research effort exploring whether space could host large-scale AI computing infrastructure. If viable, this could reshape long-term planning for AI capacity, energy constraints, and data-center economics.

articles.headline: Enterprises face governance gaps as AI agents gain more autonomy
articles.summary: TechTarget reports that recent incidents are exposing gaps in how enterprises monitor, control, and intervene when AI agents cross boundaries. This is directly relevant for companies adopting agentic workflows because it raises operational, compliance, and risk-management requirements.

articles.headline: SoftBank raises $11.1 billion in record high-yield bond sale to fund OpenAI bet
articles.summary: SoftBank completed the largest high-yield corporate bond sale on record, raising $11.1 billion to finance its investment push around OpenAI. For businesses, this signals continued capital flooding into AI infrastructure and model development, which can intensify competition for compute, cloud capacity, and related suppliers.
